objects.text: Creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with expertise in editorial design, driving audience engagement through thoughtful layout and visual narrative. Demonstrated success improving magazine reader retention and digital campaign impact by 30%+ through innovative design solutions.
• Led design for a monthly magazine publisher, increasing average page views per issue by 28% through refreshed visuals and cohesive editorial layouts.
• Collaborated with editorial team to develop 10+ thematic spreads quarterly, reducing production time by 15% via streamlined workflow templates.
• Directed rebranding of seasonal supplements, boosting subscriber retention by 18% through targeted design adjustments and consistent branding.
• Implemented digital-first design strategies that increased online edition downloads by 35% during the first 12 months.
Junior Graphic Designer — Nimbus Editorial Studios
• Created visual content for biweekly fashion and lifestyle magazines, improving reader engagement with innovative typography and layout balancing.
• Assisted senior designers in developing brand guidelines that enhanced cross-platform consistency, resulting in a 22% improvement in brand recognition surveys.
• Produced 50+ infographic designs for editorial features, supporting content comprehension and boosting social media shares by 25%.
• Coordinated with print vendors to ensure accurate color reproduction and deadline adherence, decreasing print errors by 12%.
Overhauled editorial design system for Veridian’s flagship magazine, achieving a 30% increase in subscriber engagement and streamlining visual elements to improve reader flow.
Designed inaugural digital-only supplement edition for Nimbus, reaching 15,000 downloads within the first month and setting a template for ongoing digital editorial projects.

Editorial Layout Design  ·  Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator)  ·  Typography & Visual Hierarchy  ·  Print and Digital Publishing  ·  Branding & Visual Identity  ·  Project Coordination  ·  Design Workflow Optimization
Bachelor of Fine Arts in Graphic Design, Northridge Creative University, 2018
